$comment: Catalog of what scdemos/demo already provides. The customer-demo skill maps customer components onto these before writing any new code. Keep in sync when blocks/variants/section styles change.

brandSlots.$comment: Blocks reference these palette tokens directly (~250 refs). Re-theming = re-assigning these values inside the BRAND TOKENS block at the top of styles/styles.css. Do not rename them.

colors.--color-rust: primary brand color (buttons, rust sections, links on hover)
colors.--color-parchment: light page background + light text on dark

typography.--font-family: body font stack (declared in styles/fonts.css, file in /fonts)

extraTokens.--footer-logo-filter: e.g. brightness(0) invert(1) when a dark raster logo sits on the dark footer
extraTokens.--h2-accent-display: none to hide the brand bar under h2 (base default block)

brandSlots.rgbLiterals: ~87 rgb(161 79 43 / x%), rgb(197 160 89 / x%), rgb(209 106 62 / x%), rgb(245 242 237 / x%), rgb(6 13 13 / x%), rgb(22 33 33 / x%) tints in blocks/styles: remap mechanically to the new brand rgb values.

sectionStyles.$comment: Applied with a Section Metadata block, key 'style'.
sectionStyles.head-row: heading left, lone link paragraph right (e.g. "Latest news" ... "All news")
sectionStyles.social: links rendered as raised cards with trailing icon (Stay connected)
sectionStyles.page-title: white title band: optional icon paragraph above the H1 (simple landing pages: contact, search, insights hub)
sectionStyles.band: full-bleed color band (default ink) with light text; a lone image paragraph fills the right edge; modifiers band-green | band-purple | band-blue
sectionStyles.overlap: follows a band: pulls its panel/stats/form up into the band (desktop); text before the panel and cards stats turn light
sectionStyles.tags: lists render as pill clouds (browse by tag/category/author, all tags)

hero.use: page-top banner. banner = full-bleed photo, dark scrim, white sans text (corporate/FS sites); default = faded heritage hero

cards.use: panel = one raised white panel with hairline-separated cells (capabilities, ESG, news; works with/without images); list = rows with date/title/author bylines (paragraph with headshot picture) + thumbnail; switchable adds a grid/list toggle (JS); stats = big figures; text = simple tiles; default = image grid; panel cols-4 = 4-up tiles (anchor nav strips); emphasis = larger headings in panel cells (contact cards); promo = image + text feature tile, ink = dark promo (campaign/outlook callouts); logos = partner/memberships logo wall

teaser.use: single promo: image + heading + copy + CTA

faq.use: INDEX-DRIVEN: rows are category names, Q&A come from /faq-index.json. For authored Q&A use tabs instead.

related-articles.use: auto list of articles/insights from query-index

product-grid.use: grid driven by a JSON index (products, funds, strategies)

journey-map.use: GATED step-by-step checklist ("complete each checkpoint to unlock"). Not a timeline: use table striped (Year | Milestone) for history.

compound-interest-calculator.use: financial calculator; currency/locale from metadata (currency, locale)

form.use: spreadsheet-driven form: row 1 = link to /forms/<name>.json (field,type,label,options,required,...), row 2 = submit URL (https://demo.bbird.live/contact-us/ allows any origin); panel = white raised form card. Sheet options are pipe-delimited (Asia|EMEA); end a single comma-containing option with | ; required accepts TRUE/true

n8n-form.use: form posting to an n8n webhook (contact / subscribe)

carousel.use: rotating hero/promo slides with prev/next arrows, dots (progress pill when autoplay), keyboard + reduced-motion support. Each row = image cell | content cell.

features.experimentation: plugins/experimentation: experiments, audiences, campaigns + sidekick overlay
features.martech: plugins/martech: Adobe Web SDK (alloy), Target offers incl. section-level decision scopes
features.cloneit: tools/cloneit: repoless clone of a DA template site
features.queryIndex: query.yaml (site config) feeding related-articles, search, product-grid

siteNotices.use: metadata site-gate: /fragments/<disclaimer> (modal with #agree/#cancel links; site-gate-exit for cancel) and consent: /fragments/<consent> (banner with #accept/#reject/#settings, optional category list). Choices persist in localStorage and drive Web SDK consent via martech updateUserConsent.

login.use: header builds the login/logout link to demo.bbird.live (base auth flow, keep it there); customer wording via metadata login-label / logout-label

gatedContent.use: page metadata Gated: true + section metadata View: logged-in | logged-out (teaser vs member content); author toggle on aem.page/localhost, enforced by the CDN worker + Cloudflare Access on the gated production host

templates.use: Template: article (insights/news, breadcrumb, date) and Template: events (listing); add a new template for a page type that appears on 2+ pages

mappingRules: Fidelity first: never force a customer pattern into a block if it changes the look; never drop content.

Pick the lowest level that reproduces the pattern faithfully: 0 default content, 1 existing block, 2 section style, 3 CSS-only variant, 4 variant with JS, 5 new block, 6 header/footer chrome variant via site metadata, 7 template, 8 global feature/plugin.
New block when the content model, interaction or over ~40% of the CSS differs; otherwise a variant.
Name everything generically; record level, content model and baseCandidate in this manifest.

Section-driven blocks (tabs = Tab Id/Tab title section metadata; faq = /faq-index.json; journey-map = gated checklist) must not be authored as row tables. When the original shows tiles, use cards panel; timelines use table striped.
Text on colored bands/overlaps must be verified against what is painted under it, not its DOM parent (capture.mjs readability check).
Content repeated on 2+ pages (CTA band, sign-up, disclaimer, contact strip) is one /fragments/<generic-name> doc, placed with a fragment block on each page (lint:repeat-inline).

pageMetadata.social-share: off hides the floating share dock (delayed.js)
pageMetadata.currency: ISO code for calculators (USD, TWD, CAD…)
pageMetadata.Experiment / Experiment Variants: page-level A/B: variants are full pages, relative paths OK
pageMetadata.Campaign-<name>: value must be the served URL of the campaign page: a DA doc named index is served at the FOLDER url (/campaigns/x/), not /campaigns/x/index
pageMetadata.color-scheme: light | dark | auto (default). Set light/dark site-wide in metadata.json when the customer has no dark mode, so the OS preference cannot flip the demo

header nav-layout: rail.use: fixed left icon rail for primary sections (icons via :rail-*: in nav), square brand mark (:rail-mark:), wide top search, secondary CTA buttons; collapses to hamburger below 900px

footer footer-layout: legal.use: logo + link row, copyright/legal paragraphs, stacked legal links (corporate/FS footers)

login-label / logout-label.use: metadata overrides for auth link text

baseContentMarkers.$comment: Strings that only exist in the base demo content. Any of them on a customer page means base content leaked (P6). lint-content.mjs fails on them.
